name: Atrium
author: Atrium
description: Built in: whether an address answers, the health of your other services, and this server's own CPU, memory, disk, uptime and network.

endpoints.label: Is it up
endpoints.description: Whether an address answers (below HTTP 500 within 5 seconds), and how fast. Addresses on your network work; this server itself and link-local addresses are refused.

url.title: Address
url.description: An http or https address, for example http://10.0.0.5:8096.

endpoints.label: Service health
endpoints.description: The last health check of one of your connected services, and how fast it answered.

endpoints.label: This server
endpoints.description: The Atrium server's own CPU, memory, disk, uptime or network traffic.

endpoints.label: Connected services
endpoints.description: The shared services connected to Atrium, by name.

endpoints.label: What this server reports
endpoints.description: The measures the host read can show.
